test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The amount on a sum of ₹2,800 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,800

Rate of Interest (r) = 10% per annum

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + r/100)t

**Calculation:**

A = 2800 × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ A = 2800 × (1 + 0.1)²

⇒ A = 2800 × (1.1)²

⇒ A = 2800 × 1.21

⇒ A = ₹3,388

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
